_notes.source: Live https://leelootrading.com/ Foundation account cards read in Chrome on 2026-10-20 - all six sizes, prices and rules unchanged from 2026-10-11. Also /affiliate, Trustpilot and Google Maps. Earlier sources listed in git history.
_notes.pricing: Monthly recurring subscription for Foundation (LL) accounts; reset $85. No discount shown. Bundle (LB) accounts are a one-month non-recurring bundle where only one account can qualify ($520-$950); not listed separately.
_notes.rules_detail: Foundation accounts: profit target and rising trailing max drawdown per size, minimum 10 trading days and no maximum (knowledge base title). A 30% rule applies to Performance Accounts (knowledge base title), recorded as consistency_pct 30. Payouts are made through 'Performance Accounts', which may be simulated or copied accounts at LeeLoo's discretion, so no profit split or payout cap is recorded.
_notes.countries: No restricted-countries list found on an official page.
_notes.company: Footer: 'Leeloo Trading, Montana USA', copyright 2019-2026 (not a founding statement).
_notes.vetting: Checked 2026-10-11. Trustpilot 3.1 from 608 reviews. About 10 of the 20 newest reviews described a denied payout, and the newest review was from 7 Jun 2026. The site is live with current prices. Listed with a review alert at the team's request (2026-10-11).
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official LeeLoo page we could read.
_notes.affiliate_program: https://www.leelootrading.com/affiliate (2026-10-20): run on the Impact affiliate network. 10% commission on subscription purchases; monthly bonus rate 15% when referred revenue is $5,500-$10,499.99 and 20% from $10,500. 30-day cookie; banners, content and text links on your website (so websites are explicitly allowed); custom creatives possible. Payout method follows Impact's terms (not stated on the page). No country rules stated. Apply: join via Impact (search 'LeelooTrading'), or the older form at https://members.leelootrading.com/amember/aff/signup
_notes.company_check: Google Maps search (2026-10-20) found no LeeLoo Trading listing (top result was an unrelated Dubai company).

firm.name: LeeLoo Trading
firm.about: LeeLoo Trading is a Montana-based futures firm that sells monthly practice accounts from $25K to $300K. Traders who meet its targets can move to a 'Performance Account', which LeeLoo may run as a simulated account or copy to a live account at its discretion.

review_alert.summary: Of the 20 most recent Trustpilot reviews, about 10 describe a payout being denied. No new reviews have been posted since June 2026 (checked 20 October 2026).
